question: What will be the closing value of the US dollar to Brazilian real exchange rate (USDBRL=X on Yahoo Finance) on September 2, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of USDBRL=X on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-02. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I've finished the research. A few results showed figures dated after 2026-08-05, and I left them out.

# USDBRL=X research (as of 2026-08-05)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves to the Yahoo Finance daily close of USDBRL=X for 2026-09-02. That is a Wednesday and a normal trading day in both Brazil and the US, so the fallback to an earlier close should not be needed.
- 2026-08-05: I couldn't load the Yahoo history page (the proxy refused the connection), so **I have no Yahoo-reported latest value**. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/USDBRL=X/history/)
- Yahoo's USDBRL=X is a round-the-clock FX quote. Its daily "close" often differs by a few thousandths (sometimes more) from the B3 spot close and the central bank's PTAX rate that Brazilian media report.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. Spot is around 5.07 to 5.13, in the middle-to-low part of the 4.5 to 6.0 range.
- 2026-08-05: at 9:05 local time the spot dollar was down 0.32% at R$5.116. The September future traded at R$5.146. Reasons given: a poll showing a narrower Lula vs Flávio Bolsonaro gap, and a weaker dollar globally. [Correio Web](https://www.correioweb.com.br/mercado-hoje/2026/08/7474113-dolar-hoje-05-08-2026-veja-as-informacoes-da-moeda-americana.html)
- 2026-08-04: spot closed at R$5.1309, up 0.86%, with markets watching US data. [Money Times](https://www.moneytimes.com.br/tempo-real-ibovespa-hoje-mercado-ao-vivo-04-08-2026-jals-lils-apsa/), [Drops de Jogos](https://dropsdejogos.uai.com.br/noticias/dolar-avanca-e-ibovespa-recua-em-dia-de-atencao-a-dados-dos-eua/)
- 2026-08-03: spot closed at R$5.0877, up 0.38%. [Mercado Hoje](https://mercadohoje.uai.com.br/2026/08/04/dolar-hoje-04-08-2026-veja-as-informacoes-da-moeda-americana)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-05: the Copom (the central bank's rate committee) announces its Selic decision after the market close. The Selic is 14.25%, after a 0.25 point cut in June. [Sou Brasília](https://soubrasilia.com/?p=8584)
- 2026-08-03: the Focus survey cut its year-end Selic forecast from 14.00% to 13.75%. Its year-end 2026 dollar forecast stayed at R$5.20. [InfoMoney](https://www.infomoney.com.br/economia/boletim-focus-projecoes-03082026/), [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/radioagencia-nacional/economia/audio/2026-08/boletim-focus-preve-agora-selic-em-1375-ao-final-do-ano)
- 2026-08-02: a Quaest poll had Lula at 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 30% in the first round. Election polls have clearly moved the real this year. [O Popular](https://opopular.com.br/politica/lula-tem-37-e-flavio-bolsonaro-30-no-primeiro-turno-aponta-quaest-1.3451595)
- 2026-07-31: the dollar closed at R$5.069. It fell 1.82% in July and is down 7.73% year to date. Media credit high oil prices, foreign inflows and carry trade from high Brazilian rates. [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4338632/dolar-fecha-estavel-mas-acumula-queda-de-1-82-em-julho), [Sou Brasília](https://soubrasilia.com/dolar-queda-julho-2026-fechamento-cotacao/)
- 2026-07-29: the Fed held rates at 3.50% to 3.75% in a 9-3 vote. The three dissenters (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) wanted a hike. Chair Warsh would not call it a pause, and markets reportedly see a large chance of a September hike. The dollar still weakened that day. [BabyPips](https://www.babypips.com/news/headline-why-the-dollar-sold-off-despite-three-fed-officials-voting-for-a-rate-hike-2026-07-30), [PCBB](https://www.pcbb.com/industry-insights/economy/2026-07-29-fomc-july-2026)

## 4. Base rates and typical variation
- The year-to-date drop implies a start of 2026 near R$5.49. The trend since then is clearly toward a stronger real: about 5.16 at end-June, 5.07 at end-July, and 5.09 to 5.13 in early August.
- Daily moves of 0.4% to 0.9% are common right now (for example +0.86% on Aug 4).
- My rough estimate: the real's annual volatility is typically 12% to 15%. Over the roughly 20 trading days to Sept 2, that gives a one-standard-deviation move of about 3.5% to 4%, or about ±R$0.18 to 0.20 from 5.12. I didn't check that volatility figure against a live options quote.
- Big election-poll surprises earlier in the cycle moved the rate sharply. One Quaest poll pushed it to R$5.46 (date unclear). [DGABC search result](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4344752/dolar-cai-para-r-5-10-apos-pequisa-mostrar-empate-tecnico-entre-lula-e-flavio)

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-03: Focus median for year-end 2026 is R$5.20, unchanged. [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/economia/noticia/2026-08/boletim-focus-mercado-preve-reducao-da-inflacao-e-do-pib-de-2026)
- 2026-08-05: the September future at R$5.146 implies a forward of about R$5.14 to 5.15, which is spot plus the carry. [Correio Web](https://www.correioweb.com.br/mercado-hoje/2026/08/7474113-dolar-hoje-05-08-2026-veja-as-informacoes-da-moeda-americana.html)
- Kalshi lists USD/BRL "max" ladders, which ask whether the rate touches a level by a date. On a Dec 31, 2026 ladder snapshot (timing unverified), 5.5 or higher was priced near 41%. An April 22 record had the 5.4999 contract at a 9¢ bid. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxusdbrlmax/usdbrl-max/kxusdbrlmax-26dec31), [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/api/public/market/KXUSDBRLMAX-26DEC31-T5.4999)
- 2026-06-12: a thin Polymarket market (about $838 volume) on "USD/BRL hits 5.5 in 2026" was at about 32% Yes. [Lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/finance/will-usdbrl-hit-in-2026)
- I found no market that settles on the Sept 2 close itself.

## 6. Upcoming events before Sept 2
- 2026-08-05, evening: Copom decision. A cut to 14.00% would narrow the carry; a hold would support the real.
- Around 2026-08-11: Copom minutes. Weekly Focus surveys every Monday.
- Mid-August: Brazil's IPCA inflation for July. US CPI for July is around Aug 12 to 13.
- 2026-08-16: official start of Brazil's election campaign. Free TV and radio campaign time begins in late August. Expect more Quaest, Datafolha and AtlasIntel polls, which have moved the rate this year.
- Late August: the Jackson Hole symposium (Warsh speech), with September Fed hike pricing at stake.
- Oil prices and foreign flows, which media cited as drivers of July's fall.
- 2026-08-31: month-end PTAX fixing, which can cause swings around the end of the month.
- The August US jobs report (around Sept 4) and the September Copom and FOMC meetings all come after Sept 2.
